Enabled.Name: Enable strict Fog Exploration policy
Enabled.Hint: When enabled, managed world Scenes must have Fog Exploration disabled.

RepairOnReady.Name: Repair existing Scenes when the world loads
RepairOnReady.Hint: The active GM performs an idempotent, batched repair after world startup.

EnforceCreates.Name: Enforce on newly created and imported Scenes
EnforceCreates.Hint: New world Scenes are persisted with Fog Exploration disabled, including Scenes imported from compendiums.

EnforceUpdates.Name: Prevent managed Scenes from re-enabling Fog Exploration
EnforceUpdates.Hint: Attempts to enable Fog Exploration on a managed Scene are corrected before the update is stored.

AllowExemptions.Name: Allow per-Scene exemptions
AllowExemptions.Hint: Allows the dashboard to exempt selected world Scenes from the strict policy.

NotifyAutomaticRepair.Name: Notify me after automatic repair
NotifyAutomaticRepair.Hint: Shows a GM notification when this client, as active GM, repairs Scenes at startup.

Dashboard.Name: Fog Policy Dashboard
Dashboard.Label: Open Fog Policy Dashboard
Dashboard.Hint: Audit, filter, bulk-select, repair, back up, restore, exempt, and purge Scene Fog Exploration data.

Dashboard.Title: Runyth Fog Policy
Dashboard.PolicyEnabled: Strict Fog Exploration policy is enabled
Dashboard.PolicyDisabled: Strict Fog Exploration policy is disabled
Dashboard.Intro: Managed Scenes keep Fog Exploration disabled so players retain only current visibility instead of a permanent explored-map memory.
Dashboard.PurgeWarning: Purging stored exploration permanently deletes saved FogExploration records for the chosen Scenes and users. Export a backup first when you may need to restore policy state.
Dashboard.PurgeSelectedConfirmBody: This permanently deletes stored Fog Exploration records for all users on {count} selected Scene(s). Continue?
Dashboard.SearchHelp: All terms must match. Quotes are supported. Field filters: name:, folder:, status:, fog:, exempt:, id:.
Dashboard.IncludeGlobalSettings: Include world policy settings in backup
Dashboard.RestoreFogState: Restore Fog Exploration state where policy permits
Dashboard.ImportBackupConfirmBody: Matched: {matched}. Unmatched: {unmatched}. Ambiguous: {ambiguous}. Only matched Scenes can be changed. Continue with the selected import options?
Dashboard.ReplaceSelection: Replace current selection instead of adding
Dashboard.TransferHelp: Selection files contain Scene identity and folder-path metadata only; they do not change Scene settings.
Dashboard.Failed: {operation} failed. See the notification and console details.

Notifications.Repaired: Runyth Fog Policy disabled Fog Exploration on {count} Scene(s).
Notifications.AutomaticRepair: Runyth Fog Policy automatically repaired {count} Scene(s).
Notifications.AutomaticRepairFailed: Runyth Fog Policy could not complete its automatic Scene repair. Check the browser console for the RFP error details.
Notifications.Purged: Deleted {count} stored Fog Exploration record(s) across {scenes} Scene(s).
Notifications.PurgePartial: Purge deleted {deleted} record(s), but {failures} operation(s) could not be completed. Review the console before assuming the purge is complete.
Notifications.PartialFailure: {operation} completed partially; {count} Scene(s) could not be updated. Review the console for isolated failures.
Notifications.RestoreConflicts: {count} backup Fog Exploration value(s) could not be restored because the active strict policy would immediately prohibit them. Those Scenes remain policy-compliant.
Notifications.RestoreFailed: {count} Scene backup update(s) failed after isolation. Review the console for details.
Notifications.SelectionImported: Selection import matched {matched} Scene(s); {unmatched} unmatched; {ambiguous} ambiguous.
